_comment: Other repos' deviz boards the pump serves (dv-57ba). Edited by hand only.
Each entry: name (short, lowercase; tasks show as <name>:dv-xxxx) and repo
(the repo top level, which must have .deviz/tasks/). Listing a board also
allows its repo for worktrees, branches and commits, like a repos line.
Optional intake: list = argv printing a JSON array of open items, each with
an id; close = argv run per filed item, {id} substituted; what = the noun
used in titles and messages. Both run with cwd = the board's repo.
Optional profile (dv-a438): the bot profile every job of this board runs
under (tool policy, cost attribution), and the profile whose job_start(task_id)
starts this board's tasks; default devops. Optional test: the repo's test
command, given to every job instead of 'find it in the repo's docs'.
Optional stages (dv-a438): extra pipeline stages for this board, any of
["architect", "review", "acceptance"]: architect checks each plan against the repo's
docs/REQUIREMENTS.md (and docs/features.yaml if present, dv-224f) before the
owner sees it, review reads every build step;
each may return the work once; acceptance runs `acceptance.command` (argv,
cwd = the task's worktree) after review and judges the architect's criteria,
and runs only on a board with that block. Default none.
Optional acceptance.light_args (dv-7a10): argv appended to the command for a
task the architect (or the owner's answer) set to `light`; without it light runs full.
Optional acceptance.full_paths (dv-87b4): globs (fnmatch, `*` crosses `/`) of
schema/migration/DB/test-infra files; a branch diff touching one raises the task
to full, and so do a `pytest.` criterion tag and a perf/db/migration/load/scale
label; otherwise the architect's level (none = light where light_args exist).
Optional acceptance.max_minutes (dv-2514, default 60): the pump runs the command
itself before the acceptance agent starts; past this it is killed as a hang
(a mechanical stop, one auto-retry, then the owner), never a FAIL.
On a board with acceptance, build/review/test design run changed-area tests only.
This repo's own board takes them from PUMP_OWN_STAGES (default architect,review).
Optional deploy (dv-2263): where the board's prod says what it runs, so a
merged card can be marked live (pump_live, status done). Either log = an
absolute path to a deploy.py-style journal (`<ts> <old> -> <new> build=<b> ok`;
`rolled-back` lines put the old sha back), or started = argv printing when prod
last started (ISO or systemd @unix): live once it started after the merge.
Without it merges are tracked but never called live, and the pin never warns.
This repo's own board uses claude-bot's systemd start time.
This repo's own board is always served and needs no entry.
